("ALEXANDRIA" OR THE "COMPANY") (NYSE: ARE) TODAY ANNOUNCED THAT THE UNDERWRITERS OF ITS PREVIOUSLY ANNOUNCED UNDERWRITTEN PUBLIC OFFERING OF 7,000,000 SHARES OF THE COMPANY'S COMMON STOCK FULLY EXERCISED THEIR OPTION TO PURCHASE AN ADDITIONAL 1,050,000 SHARES OF THE COMPANY'S COMMON STOCK AT A PUBLIC OFFERING PRICE OF $184.00 PER SHARE.
